forces a line break at the current position (css-text-3 §5.1): one
two yields two line boxes; a

b yields an empty interior line box (full line height, no ink); a trailing br does not produce a trailing line box; a leading br produces an empty first line. The br contributes no advance and is not a block or replaced box.
